source_text: Addam plagas septies. Incrementum poenae ad conversionem. Noli cervicem indurare.
pass_a_gloss: I-will-add plagues sevenfold. Increase of-penalty unto conversion. Do-not neck harden.
pass_b_english: I will add [[plagues sevenfold >> Bible:Leviticus 26:18-21]]. Penalty increases toward conversion. Do not harden the neck.
